text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …What's going on here? It's not even cold out, but here I am shiver'n away…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While Yukino Bijin does seem to be trembling a little, it doesn't look like nerves.
choice_data_list: Looks like you're ready to rumble.
Looks like you're ready to rumble.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Rumble? …Hey, I think I figured it out. Is this what they call "trembl'n with excitement"?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It's like y'said, Trainer. I wanna win so bad, I'm practic'lly shak'n!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Keep your peepers on me! By the time the race's over, your socks and shoes'll be blown clean off your tootsies!
